name: Guaramirim (Brazil)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms with a mural crown, a scarlet ibis (guará) on a landscape, over a scroll reading GUARAMIRIM.
history: Guaramirim is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil, named after the guará, the scarlet ibis shown on its arms. Flags of the World quotes the law: white identifies the purity of mind of the people, and the prosperity and work that led to greatness.
